prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1006; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the right rear quarter panel and rear bumper cover shows scraping, a cracked corner of the bumper cover, and a dented rear door skin, consistent with a sideswipe while changing lanes. The damage pattern lines up with the impact as described. Repair is planned as panel straightening, refinishing of the door and quarter panel, and replacement of the bumper cover, with labor hours that fit the damage shown. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from the file or from the inspection. Two similar charges posted on the same day are currently being verified before the estimate is finalized.
